_about: Explore Actions panel content. 'actions' holds one entry per kind of action, shown as one list in this order. Text may use {revives} (Pokémon Center revives) and {returnTo} (the Battle Frontier's return city, read from the map). An action only shows on a region's panel if that region's board has it. 'gateMarkers' is a second list shown below it under its own header (the section is left out while 'entries' is empty); an entry shows on every map unless it has a "regions": ["kanto", ...] list naming the maps it is for. 'regions.<region>.<id>' overrides name/desc/icon for just that map, for actions and gate markers alike -- use it for the game-specific sprites. An empty override value is ignored, so a blank "icon" is safe to leave as a template. Icons are image URLs (or paths relative to index.html); with none, a placeholder square shows. An icon keeps its own proportions (up to 52px wide and 160px tall), so a tall one makes its card taller.

gym-battle.name: Gym Battle
gym-battle.desc: Challenge the Gym Leader. If you win, you earn their Gym Badge!

villain-battle.name: Villain Battle
villain-battle.desc:
Battle this Region's Villainous Organization. If you win, you gain a Master Ball card from the Reward Item deck.

(Limit one Master Ball per player.)

elite-four-battle.name: Battle Elite Four
elite-four-battle.desc: Face a member of this Region’s Elite Four. If you win, you gain the right to face the Champion next!

champion-battle.name: Battle Champion
champion-battle.desc: Only those who have proven their skills by defeating a member of the Elite Four may challenge the Champion. Take them on and prove that you are the greatest Pokémon Master. If you defeat the Champion, you win the game!

victory.name: Enter the Hall of Fame
victory.desc: Only those who have defeated the Champion may enter the Hall of Fame.

poke-mart.name: Poké Mart
poke-mart.desc: Draw a card from the Item deck.

pokemon-center.name: Pokémon Center
pokemon-center.desc: Heal your team! Every Status Condition is removed, and up to {revives} Fainted Pokémon are Revived. If more than {revives} Pokémon are Fainted, you choose which ones are Revived.

department-store.name: Department Store
department-store.desc: Look at the top 2 cards of the Item deck and put 1 into your hand. The other goes to the bottom of the Item deck.

safari-zone.name: Safari Zone
safari-zone.desc: Discard an Item card from your hand, then choose a Yellow Pokémon from storage and roll the Catch Die. On a Catch Total of 4 or more, you catch the Pokémon (2 or more if you discarded a Safari Ball). No Catch Cards can be played. Any uncaught Pokémon return to storage.

battle-frontier.name: Battle Frontier
battle-frontier.desc:
Choose a Pokémon token color. Draw a random Pokémon token of that color. Battle it under Wild Encounter condition, except you may not Catch it. Defeat it to claim that color’s reward:

Pink: If one of your Pokémon gained a Level from this Battle, it gains an additional Level.

Green: Draw a card from the Item deck.

Blue: Look at the top 2 cards of the Item deck. Put 1 into your hand and the other on the bottom of the deck.

Yellow: Draw 3 Yellow Pokémon tokens from storage and choose one of them. You may attempt to Catch that Pokémon. If you do, add 2 to your Catch Roll. No Catch Cards can be played. Any uncaught Pokémon is returned to storage.

Red: Look at the top 3 cards of the Item deck. Put 1 into your hand, and the others on the bottom of the deck. Choose up to one Pokémon on your team that is below Level 5. It gains a Level.

Legendary: Take 1 Item card of your choice from the Item deck or Item discard pile (if you take it from the deck, shuffle the deck). Choose up to one Pokémon on your team that is below Level 5. It gains a Level. (This reward may be claimed only once per player.)

If you lose the Battle, or end the Battle without defeating the Pokémon, move to {returnTo} and immediately end your turn.

gain-item.name: Gain Item
gain-item.desc: Find the named Item card in either the Reward Items deck or the Shop deck and put it into your hand.

roll-for-item.name: Roll For Item
roll-for-item.desc: Roll a d6. Find the Item card that corresponds to the result from either the Reward Items deck or the Shop deck and add it to your hand. Each location with this action has a different set of items available.

badge-gate.name: Badge Gate
badge-gate.desc: This gate blocks your travel along the path. To traverse it, you must have earned a Gym Badge whose Tier matches or exceeds that of the pictured Gym Badge.

badge-points-gate.name: Badge Points Gate
badge-points-gate.desc:
This gate blocks your travel along the path. To traverse it, you must have earned Gym Badges whose total Badge Points meet or exceed the Badge Point Requirement for the game's chosen length.

Short: 18 Badge Points
Medium: 32 Badge Points
Long: 52 Badge Points

item-gate.name: Item Gate
item-gate.desc: This gate blocks your travel along the path. To traverse it, you must have the Item card whose illustration matches the gate icon in play.

pokemon-gate.name: Pokémon Gate
pokemon-gate.desc: This gate blocks your travel past this space. To traverse beyond it, any player must have defeated or caught the Pokémon pictured in the gate icon.

surf-gate.name: Surf Gate
surf-gate.desc: This gate blocks your travel along the path. To traverse it, you must have a Pokémon on your team that has the SURF ability.

villain-gate.name: Villain Gate
villain-gate.desc: This gate blocks your travel along the path. To traverse it, you must have defeated the Region's Villainous Organization.
